segments.name: programmable logic semiconductor
segments.description: Develops programmable logic semiconductor technologies, eFPGA IP, and discrete FPGA devices for aerospace, defense, industrial, and computing markets.
segments.evidence: We develop programmable logic semiconductor technologies, including embedded Field Programmable Gate Array ("eFPGA") intellectual property ("IP") and specialized FPGA devices used in a range of applications requiring adaptable hardware functionality.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for eFPGA IP licenses, related professional services, and sales of FPGA hardware products and royalties.
revenueModel.evidence: eFPGA IP revenue is comprised primarily of eFPGA intellectual property license revenue, eFPGA-related professional services revenue, and eFPGA-related support and maintenance revenue.
